# BESTMT4EA

> Myfxbook-verified MT4 and MT5 expert advisors (EAs), indicators and free
> trading tools. Every system is traded on a real account before release, and
> each page states the broker, the account type and the maximum drawdown behind
> any figure shown. Products are sold with a per-account licence and delivered
> from the BestMT4EA dashboard.

This file is a map for AI assistants and answer engines. Every link is a public
page with a short note on what it contains. Long-form guides are written to be
read directly: they state the problem, the honest limits, and the numbers behind
any claim. Performance figures come from real Myfxbook accounts and are labelled
live or demo.

## Start here

- [All expert advisors](https://bestmt4ea.com/shop/): The full catalogue of MT4/MT5 systems with prices and licence tiers.
- [Top ranking](https://bestmt4ea.com/top-ranking/): Every system ranked by verified total gain against maximum drawdown.
- [Best MT4 EAs](https://bestmt4ea.com/best-mt4-ea/): Expert advisors built for MetaTrader 4.
- [Best MT5 EAs](https://bestmt4ea.com/best-mt5-ea/): Expert advisors built for MetaTrader 5.
- [Best forex EAs](https://bestmt4ea.com/best-forex-ea/): The whole EA catalogue on one board.
- [Best forex brokers](https://bestmt4ea.com/best-forex-brokers/): The brokers used to verify tracked performance.
